effects.label: Study 2 humans: CBR choices when CBR coincides with omission minus when it coincides with action

reported.no_uncertainty: the printed t is an emmeans contrast from one ANOVA pooling humans and the four LLMs (aov_ez between = dilemma x framing x model; df 2943 = all rows of every model); its SE uses the pooled residual and the LLM rows, not the human sample alone; per-cell human n not printed

n_human_derived.arithmetic: pooled t(2943): 2943 + 60 cells (6 dilemmas x 2 framings x 5 populations) = 3003 rows; each human-vs-LLM F(1, 963) = 987 rows in 24 cells, so every LLM has 672 valid rows (56 x 12); 3003 - 4 x 672 = 315 human rows (Base + Action-Omission)
n_human_derived.split_note: the split of these rows into the two framing groups (e.g. om_frame action vs omission) is not determined by the printed df: a group mixes base rows of some dilemmas with reframed rows of others; so no exact k/n per printed percentage -> no_uncertainty kept
